verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Rippling syncs time off and hours into payroll automatically (docs-18, docs-25) and lets employees request time off in the app (docs-28), implying some PTO-to-payroll integration, but there is no explicit documentation of configuring accrual rules, tiered accrual policies, or multi-step approval workflows for PTO specifically. Missing for 10: explicit PTO policy/accrual rule builder, approval routing configuration, and any hands-on or independent confirmation of accrual-to-payroll automation.
